background: Morgan Stanley is the holding company of a leading US investment bank whose earnings have shifted toward wealth and investment management alongside institutional securities, with a deposit franchise built on brokerage sweeps.
synthesis: Morgan Stanley is rated A on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A-, all three on a stable outlook, with no rating action since a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 4 Nov 2022. CET1 of 14.9% and LCR of 129% are both in the top quarter of US banks, but leverage of 4.9% is in the bottom quarter and has fallen 0.6 points since 30 Jun 2025, the weak spot typical of a balance sheet heavy in securities (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The items flagged, the newest on 25 Sep 2026, concern an email that accidentally shared the Asia deal pipeline with clients, an operational lapse rather than a credit matter.
